map.📝 耐压（试验/安全/爆破）测试: 📝 Pressure Vessel Pressure Test & Safety Assessment
map.压力容器耐压试验与爆破压力计算，输入设计参数依据GB/T 150计算试验压力、爆: From design and working pressure, material tensile and yield strength, vessel bore and wall thickness, compute test pressure, hold time, burst pressure and safety factor per pressure-vessel rules.
map.📖 查看「耐压（试验/安全/爆破）测试使用指南」: 📖 View Pressure Vessel (Test / Safety / Burst) Guide
map.试验压力 Pt = Pd × 系数（液压 1.25 / 气压 1.15）；爆破压: Test pressure Pt = Pd × factor (hydraulic 1.25 / pneumatic 1.15); burst pressure Pb = 2·t·σb·φ ÷ (Di + t − t/10); safety factor n = Pb ÷ Pd; yield pressure Py = 2·t·σs·φ ÷ (Di + t); test stress = Pd·factor·(Di+t) ÷ (2·t·φ); hold time by bore: ≤300mm use 10/5 min, ≤1000mm use 20/10 min, larger use 30/15 min
map.压力容器耐压试验与安全评定：试验压力按设计压力乘系数（液压试验 1.25、气压试: Pressure-vessel pressure test and safety assessment: test pressure = design pressure × factor (hydraulic 1.25, pneumatic 1.15 for safety), hold time by vessel bore. Burst pressure by the thin-wall cylinder formula from wall thickness, tensile strength and weld factor, divided by design pressure gives the safety factor (generally ≥3.0 to pass). Yield pressure uses the same formula with yield strength; the test-stress to yield-strength ratio shows whether the test enters plasticity.

map.压力容器耐压试验与爆破压力计算工具，输入设计压力、材料强度、壁厚等参数，依据GB: Pressure-vessel pressure-test and burst-pressure tool: input design pressure, material strength and wall thickness to compute test pressure, burst pressure and safety margin per GB/T 150.

map.压力容器出厂耐压试验：由设计压力确定试验压力与保压时间，编制试验方案。: Factory pressure test: set test pressure and hold time from design pressure, prepare the test plan.
map.在役容器安全评定：由材料强度与壁厚估算爆破压力与安全系数，判断剩余安全裕度。: In-service safety assessment: estimate burst pressure and safety factor from material strength and wall thickness to judge remaining margin.
map.试验工况应力校核：计算试验压力下的筒体应力与屈服强度之比，判断是否进入塑性。: Test-condition stress check: compute the shell stress to yield-strength ratio under test pressure to judge plasticity.
map.内径 800 mm 容器液压试验评定: Hydraulic test assessment of an 800 mm bore vessel
map.设计压力 1.6 MPa、工作压力 1.5 MPa、材料抗拉强度 510 MPa: Design pressure 1.6 MPa, working 1.5 MPa, tensile 510 MPa, yield 345 MPa, bore 800 mm, wall 10 mm, weld factor 0.85; hydraulic test: test pressure = 1.6 × 1.25 = 2.0 MPa, bore ≤1000 mm hold 20 min; burst pressure ≈ 2×10×510×0.85 ÷ (800+10−1) ≈ 10.7 MPa, safety factor ≈ 10.7 ÷ 1.6 ≈ 6.7 (≥3.0 pass); yield pressure ≈ 7.24 MPa; test stress ≈ 95.3 MPa, about 27.6% of yield, no plasticity.
map.试验压力系数为什么液压比气压高？: Why is the hydraulic factor higher than the pneumatic?
map.液压试验取 1.25、气压试验取 1.15。气压试验储存的弹性能大、破裂时危害更: Hydraulic 1.25, pneumatic 1.15. Pneumatic stores more elastic energy and is more hazardous on rupture, so its factor is slightly lower to control risk, with stricter safety and isolation measures.
map.按薄壁圆筒公式估算的爆破压力与设计压力之比一般要求 ≥3.0，工具依此判定合格与: The burst-to-design pressure ratio from the thin-wall formula generally needs ≥3.0; the tool judges pass/fail by this. Actual assessment should also combine weld inspection, corrosion allowance and code requirements.
map.按容器内径分档：液压试验内径 ≤300 mm 取 10 min、≤1000 mm: By vessel bore: hydraulic ≤300 mm use 10 min, ≤1000 mm use 20 min, larger use 30 min; pneumatic uses 5 / 10 / 15 min. During hold check for leakage and deformation.
map.试验压力依据GB/T 150应为设计压力的1.25倍（液压试验）: Per GB/T 150, test pressure is 1.25× design pressure (hydraulic test)
map.气压试验压力为设计压力的1.15倍，需采取安全防护措施: Pneumatic test pressure is 1.15× design pressure; safety measures required
map.爆破压力通常为设计压力的3-4倍以上: Burst pressure is usually over 3–4× design pressure
map.试验介质温度不低于15°C（碳钢），保压时间≥10-30分钟: Test medium temperature not below 15°C (carbon steel); hold time ≥10–30 min
map.试验过程中严禁带压紧固螺栓或敲击承压部件: During test, never tighten bolts or strike pressure parts under pressure
